invariants: Telemetry Event is immutable and remains owned by Shared Capabilities
tenant scope is mandatory and no wildcard/default tenant fallback is allowed
Case-link, Artifact proposal and Evidence-candidate mutations are excluded from this bounded wave
no parser engine, entity-resolution engine, storage engine, provider or final query dialect is selected
raw/rendered access is supplied by explicit server-side access decisions; this wave does not invent a new permission namespace
no dedicated Event Inspector Screen ID or final detailed UI is invented by this wave
security_properties: perm.shared-capabilities.telemetry-event.read is required before any Event projection is returned
raw denial never leaks raw payload, raw-derived sensitive values or inferred raw content
rendered access may remain available when raw access is denied
source fields, derived enrichments and parser metadata remain explicitly distinguished
all projection and pivot outputs preserve tenant, environment, event identity, provenance and correlation

migration.rationale: first bounded Event Inspection core is in-process and persistence-neutral

rollback.strategy: revert the current bounded task and keep downstream tasks blocked
verification: no ledger claim is created before bounded closure

title: Implement immutable permission-gated Event inspection projection
goal: Implement the standard-library Event inspection projection that validates tenant/event identity, permission decisions, raw/rendered separation, source/parser metadata and derived enrichment provenance.
outputs: derived enrichment provenance and stale markers
acceptance_tests: event read denial returns no projection
raw denied/rendered allowed returns rendered only
raw and rendered are never synthesized from one another
derived enrichments remain labeled and source provenance is stable

performance_budget.rationale: local projection overhead can be measured independently of provider/network retrieval
metrics: bounded local inspection-projection p95 target declared by A-BOUNDARY

definition_of_done: read-only Event inspection states are executable
runtime has zero external dependencies unless separately reviewed
Telemetry Event source is never mutated
permission and tenant failures are fail-closed
